_comment: Sheldon policy manifest. Strategy decisions live here. George enforces the matching execution rails from execution_limits.json.

scoring._comment: source: 'missy' consumes Missy's default pool score; 'local' re-runs Sheldon's own pool scoring (kept for backtesting). position_source: 'missy' scores positions from Missy's versioned position_features vector (policy stays Sheldon's); 'local' re-derives inputs from the raw position record. min_open_score raised 70->90, version 1->2 (owner default 2026-10-10, calibration item): 90 is ~p84 of the observed Missy score distribution (last 8 scans; open rate 91%->48% of eligible; local scorer equivalent ~16%).

pool_eligibility._comment_deprecated: Missy now owns min_pool_liquidity_usd, min_24h_volume_usd, min_fee_tvl_ratio, max_volatility_pct, max_turnover_ratio. Sheldon keeps allowed_bin_steps, min_open_score, windows, sizing, add/remove policy.

readiness._comment: Phase 1 (2026-10-09): structured pre-open readiness. All checks mandatory in one cycle; a stale or missing scan blocks an open (fail closed).

sol._comment: Phase 1 (2026-10-09): real rent/fee/reserve model. reserve_lamports 20M -> 60M (owner default 2026-10-10, bug #5): must cover George's worst-case open SOL overhead (meteora 60M, calibrated from the 2026-10-10 live-fire opens) so a dust sweep never starves the next open.

rotation._comment: Phase 2 (2026-10-09): rotation open requires close + position + wallet + token + SOL confirmation. Declared here; enforcement lands in Phase 2.
